name: Ramli of the Arus
bio: Ramli is the Arus's factor. After entering the wrong unit he will ask a boatman to repeat the measure even when a buyer is waiting over his shoulder.
notes: gameplay: Ramli is a new name for the previously unnamed factor on Awang Musa's Arus, a Perak perahu carrying cast tin. His mistake is a copied number without its scale, not concealment (data/inspections/case_003.json)
gameplay: His regional bloc is an indexing convenience, not a historical assignment of Perak to the Javanese shahbandar (docs/research/port-official.md §3)

gameplay: Name the scale on tin declarations and Ramli helps the weighers apply the rule to later arrivals; leave it to judgement and he pays for a second weighing rather than risk another hold (data/events/ev_two_dacing_petition.json; docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §08)
